sections.heading: What is a managed website for a fencing, concrete or remodeling company?
body: A managed website for a fencing, concrete or remodeling company is a professionally designed website that SynergyFirst Digital hosts, maintains and supports for one monthly fee, with no upfront design fee. It is built around how people choose a contractor for a project: examples of finished work, the area you cover, and a fast way to request a quote or call.
Plans start at $249 per month with no activation fee, and every business can see a free, private preview before paying.

sections.heading: Why fencing, concrete and remodeling websites lose jobs they should win
sections.intro: These are high-value projects that customers compare carefully. These are the gaps we see most often.

items.title: Finished work is hard to see
items.body: Without clear project photos, a homeowner cannot judge the quality of what you build, so they keep looking.

items.title: Every type of work is squeezed onto one page
items.body: A fence, a driveway and a kitchen are different projects. Without a clear path for each, visitors are unsure you handle theirs.

items.title: The service area is unclear
items.body: If visitors cannot quickly tell whether you cover their town, they do not enquire.

items.title: No easy way to ask for a quote
items.body: Most of these jobs are quoted after a site visit. A short request form captures customers who would rather write than call.

items.title: The phone number is hard to find
items.body: Customers who are ready to talk should not have to hunt for how to reach you.

items.title: Trust is left to chance
items.body: Licence and insurance details where they apply, warranty terms, reviews and past work belong where customers look for reassurance.

sections.heading: What we build into a fencing, concrete or remodeling website
sections.intro: Every site is custom-designed around how your customers choose a contractor.

items.title: A project gallery that sells the work
items.body: Clear photos of finished projects, grouped by type, so customers can judge the results before they enquire.

items.title: A separate path for each type of work
items.body: Clear sections for fencing, concrete and remodeling, each with a call or quote request beside it.

items.title: Click-to-call on every page
items.body: Your number stays one tap away on phones, so ready customers can reach you without searching.

items.title: Service-area clarity
items.body: State where you work, so visitors can see straight away that you cover their location.

items.title: A home for reviews, warranties and credentials
items.body: Space for the licences, reviews and warranty terms you can genuinely show, placed where customers look for reassurance.

items.title: A simple quote-request form
items.body: A short, accessible form where customers describe the project, so you can plan the site visit.
